events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite iconic moment or track from the Oasis legend?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo single 'Imagine' was released in the UK in 1975, following its US single release in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine 51 years
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message, still as powerful today.

events.title: The first iPod was released
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod in October 2001, revolutionising how we listened to music on the go.

angles.name: Pocket full of tunes
angles.copy: Remember the first time you saw an iPod? 25 years ago, Apple dropped a game-changer that put 1,000 songs in your pocket. What was on your first playlist?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic British secret agent and the film franchise.

angles.name: Shaken, not stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite 007 movie moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend, John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incredible life and music of John Lennon. His legacy continues to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From silly walks to classic hotel chaos, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album,' was released in November 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Over five decades since its release, The Beatles' 'White Album' remains a monumental and diverse masterpiece. What's your standout track from the double LP?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the world lost Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, who passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we said goodbye to a true legend, Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul,' in December 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Sounds
angles.copy: A masterpiece turns another year older! The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped 61 years ago today, marking a pivotal moment in music history.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of music icon John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on the 46th anniversary of his passing. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally.
